references.text: Here reference is made to an angel who gives guidance in a dream, similar to how Joseph receives instructions in a dream.
This verse speaks of God's protection, which can be seen as parallel to God's protection of Jesus through the angel's warning.
Joseph receives a message from an angel in a dream, which is a direct parallel to the event in Matthew 2:13.
The angel again gives instructions to Joseph in a dream, showing a pattern of divine guidance through dreams.
This verse speaks of flight and protection, which can be related to Joseph and his family's flight to Egypt.
